title: m5stack/m5stack-linux-dtoverlays #18: brcm,ccode-map-trivial is the correct DT fix for CardputerZero 12/13-channel scans

execution.environment: macOS arm64; no CardputerZero hardware; local Device Service cardputer-zero profile supported=false creatable=false backend_ready=false, missing __missing_qemu__/__missing_rom__, Linux ARM64 backend excluded from ESP emulator

evidence_class: code-level verification plus host-level device-tree check; no hardware or virtual-device runtime

checks.name: issue_open_no_prior_reply
checks.evidence: state=open, comments=0, no related PR; evidence/issue-18.json

checks.name: driver_failure_path
checks.evidence: 43439 absent from brmcf_use_iso3166_ccode_fallback() (cfg80211.c:8266-8280); translate returns -EINVAL (8282-8310); country iovar never written (8606-8610); evidence/kernel-ccode-path.txt

checks.name: property_semantics
checks.evidence: brcm,ccode-map-trivial sets trivial_ccode_map (of.c:31-32), only read for brcm,bcm4329-fmac nodes (of.c:124-127); binding defines cc -> {cc,0} (yaml:91-99); evidence/kernel-ccode-path.txt

checks.name: dtb_target_path
checks.evidence: /soc/mmcnr@7e300000/wifi@1 exists in CM0 DTB with compatible brcm,bcm4329-fmac; DT source bcm270x.dtsi:50 and bcm2710-rpi-cm0.dts:152-154; evidence/overlay-dt-check.txt

checks.name: patched_overlay_build_and_apply
checks.evidence: v3 and v5 patched overlays compile with cpp+dtc and apply to the CM0 DTB via fdtoverlay (exit 0); property lands on wifi@1; evidence/overlay-dt-check.txt

checks.name: shipped_prebuilt_dtbo
checks.evidence: firmware/CardputerZero/overlays/cardputerzero-overlay.dtbo (6535 bytes, last changed 2026-02-08) has no mmcnr fragment and no brcm,ccode-map-trivial; it must be regenerated if stock images ship it

checks.name: hardware_validation
checks.evidence: no CardputerZero hardware; reporter's GB scan/connect result not independently reproduced

checks.name: virtual_device_validation
checks.evidence: cardputer-zero profile supported=false creatable=false backend_ready=false, missing QEMU/ROM, Linux ARM64 backend; no CYW43439 model; evidence/device-service-profile.json

checks.name: end_to_end_country_set
checks.evidence: no run of raspi-config / iw reg set + scan on channels 12/13, no reboot or runtime country switch

checks.name: other_iso_country_codes
checks.evidence: trivial map uses revision 0; only GB is reported as tested by the issue author

limitations: No hardware validation and no virtual-device validation in this environment.
Host-level DT check proves the overlay compiles and applies, not that the firmware accepts GB or scans channels 12/13.
The CYW43439 CLM may require non-zero revisions for some countries; the trivial map assumes ISO code plus revision 0.
The committed prebuilt dtbo under firmware/CardputerZero/overlays does not contain the change and needs regeneration.
